preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**6 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each number ai on the vertices is between 1 and 10^6.
There are exactly n-1 edges, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(max(a[x-1], a[y-1]) - min(a[x-1], a[y-1]) for x, y in edges)
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of the differences between the maximum and minimum values of ai on each edge.
